name: Monsoon Current
scope: Declared 77–83 E Sri Lanka regional summer reach, oriented eastward. Gates and connecting vertices are selected by OSW; neither gate is a physical whole-current endpoint. Excludes Arabian Sea source branches, Laccadive circulation, Bay of Bengal continuation, equatorial jets and subsurface counterflows. Different seasonal drawings do not diagnose occupied footprints or annual extrema.
layer: Seasonal near-surface regional geography. Historical section evidence is shallow and depth dependent; no fixed-depth velocity axis reconstructed and undercurrents excluded.
time_convention: Boreal summer source convention, June–September. Historical review and section context, not a simultaneous dated trajectory or current-year climatology.
source_locator: Schott and McCreary (2001), section 5.1.5, printed pp. 63–65 / PDF indices 62–64: seasonal directions/months, Sri Lanka bottleneck and separate upper-layer/undercurrent flows. August 1993 and January 1991 sections provide local latitude context, not regional axis vertices.
source_citation: Schott and McCreary (2001), The monsoon circulation of the Indian Ocean, Progress in Oceanography 51, 1–123, doi:10.1016/S0079-6611(01)00083-0.
source_license: Factual geography paraphrased with attribution; no source figures, curves or velocity fields reproduced.
coordinate_selection: 77 E and 83 E are held editorial regional gates spanning the Sri Lanka passage. Nominal 4 N crossing at 80.5 E follows the described August 1993 local core as orientation only; remaining vertices and northeastward bend are editorial. Alternative mid-route latitude shifts and independent endpoint latitude offsets test drawing choices, not observations or annual extrema.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Editorial middle-vertex latitude shift; not a current edge or another month.

scenario_rule: Three declared shapes with fixed longitude gates and independent start/end latitude offsets -0.25/0/+0.25 degrees: 27 editorial cases. Not seasonal minima/maxima, uncertainty or width bounds.
remaining_gates: Review the regional gate/axis choices against compatible seasonal velocity fields.

source_season_convention.source_locator: Section 5.1.5, printed p. 63: June–September eastward SMC; November–February westward NMC.
